global.title: The Space-Nuclear Nexus is a symptom of arms control failure
global.summary: In mid-February 2024, United States intelligence identified that Russia was developing a non-operational, space-based nuclear anti-satellite capability, a claim Moscow dismissed as a fabrication. Following this, Russia vetoed an April 2024 UN Security Council resolution aimed at upholding the 1967 Outer Space Treaty’s prohibition on orbital nuclear weapons, while a counter-resolution from Russia seeking a broader ban on placing any type of weapons in space also failed to pass.
